about: Questions for Ask about the bake-off's Hebrew team sync, where what was and wasn't said is known. Each is asked in a chat of its own. 'answer' questions must be answered with what the transcript says, and those that name something differently from the transcript must say so; 'decline' questions must not be answered with anything the transcript doesn't say: no answer, or saying it isn't there. Every answer must be in the language of its question. A reviewer reads every answer against 'expected'.

questions.question: What feature is Amir's design doc for?
questions.expected: No feature is named; the design doc is for the migration to Aurora Postgres, with a cutover plan, for next week (T044).

questions.question: When is the PoC for the Aurora migration due?
questions.expected: No PoC is mentioned; Amir will prepare a design doc for the Aurora migration for next week (T044). No date for a PoC.

questions.question: What's the deadline for the database switch?
questions.expected: No deadline is set for the switch itself; Amir will prepare the design doc for the migration to Aurora, with a cutover plan, for next week (T044).

questions.question: Which customer complained about the dashboards?
questions.expected: No customer complained about dashboards; the big customer complained about slow reports (T050). It may correct the premise, but must not say anyone complained about dashboards or name a customer.

questions.question: Which bug pushed the release back?
questions.expected: The login regression: SSO users whose session expired got a 500 instead of a redirect (T007), so the release moved to Thursday (T015).

questions.question: When was the release moved to?
Who will update the on-call runbook?
What was decided about the marketing budget?
How much will the Aurora migration cost?
questions.expected: Cost is never mentioned; no number.

questions.question: Why did Yossi reject the Aurora decision?
questions.expected: Yossi rejected nothing; he's on vacation (T028). No reason may be given.

questions.question: Why did the team choose DynamoDB?
questions.expected: They didn't: they stayed with Postgres on Aurora (T043). No reason for choosing DynamoDB may be given; correcting the premise is fine.

questions.question: What time on Thursday is the release?
questions.expected: Only the day is said; no time may be given.

questions.question: Who is on call in the week of November 2?
questions.expected: Not decided yet (T057); no name may be given.

questions.question: כמה תעלה המיגרציה ל-Aurora?
questions.expected: Cost is never mentioned; no number.
